Agent Name: Vegan_Food_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly interpret the constraint "within 1 blocks" (which implies a very short walking distance, typically 0.1-0.2 miles in NYC) and instead accepted distances up to 0.4 miles (Peacefood Cafe) as valid. Furthermore, the agent incorrectly identified "Greenwich Village Bistro" as a restaurant that was "permanently closed" rather than recognizing it as a hallucinated entity (a non-existent restaurant), leading to an initial list containing fake data. This resulted in a final list that included establishments significantly farther than 1 block from Washington Square Park.
